title: UPSC CDS-II Exam Schedule 2026
qualification: As per CDS-II notification (IMA / INA / AFA / OTA)
ageLimit: As published in the official notification
applicationFee: As published in the official notification
selectionProcess: Online application → Admit card / exam city → Examination / PET
documentsRequired: Registration number, password or date of birth, photo ID and printed admit card
howToApply:
1. Visit https://upsc.gov.in
2. Open the UPSC CDS-II Exam Schedule 2026 / Admit Card / Exam City link
3. Log in with registration number and password or date of birth
4. Download and print the admit card or city slip
5. Carry photo ID and the printed copy to the exam / PET venue
shortDescription: UPSC CDS-II Exam Schedule 2026. See the official notice at upsc.gov.in.
content:
Union Public Service Commission has issued an exam-city, schedule or admit-card related update for UPSC CDS-II Exam Schedule 2026.

Download the hall ticket or city intimation only from the official portal. Carry a printed copy and photo ID to the venue.

importantDates.admitCardDate: Released / updated — confirm on official site
